description: Reference data-freshness block for every report (Refactoring.md step 43, model of ClientB Sales_ClientB 2026-11-02 / 03): table 'Date Last Refreshed' (SQL native query from Power Loader\PROD\BI_DataFreshness_Sales.sql - replace its placeholders, needs the M parameters Server / DB; stays in the refresh, step 39 exception) + 2 hidden measures for _Measures, folder Labels: [Label Data Freshness] (3-line top-right label) and [Tooltip Data Freshness] (text of tooltip page TTDataFreshness; fill the refresh times per project). Both need CT_Language[Selected Culture] (CT_Language.json). Apply: table + measures via TOM / TMDL, then refresh the table once (new M source); report part (button, icon on CT_BlankTable[Info] from CT_BlankTable.json, tooltip page, position) - step 43. Change log: 2026-11-03 (2) "-" for a missing time (FORMAT of BLANK returns "", COALESCE never fired); (1) created.

columns.name: Date Last Refreshed
columns.description: Report refresh time (Israel time) - when Power BI ran the SQL query.

columns.name: Power Loader Loaded
columns.description: Last Power Loader write into the sales table (Israel time) = the data in the report is as of this moment.

columns.name: Last Doc Entered
columns.description: Last invoice / credit note entered in SAP (CreateDate + DocTime, Israel time).

source.expression:
let
    // SQL = project copy of Power Loader\PROD\BI_DataFreshness_Sales.sql (PROD\<CLIENT>\BI_DataFreshness_Sales_<CLIENT>.sql, placeholders replaced; keep in sync): 3 times in Israel time.
    Source = Sql.Database ( Server, DB, [ Query = "/*#(lf)    BI data freshness - template (Power BI native query on the SQL Server of the client, one row, 3 times in Israel time):#(lf)    - BIRefreshed       - when Power BI ran this query = report refresh time;#(lf)    - PowerLoaderLoaded - last write of Power Loader into the sales table = the data in the report is as of this moment;#(lf)    - LastDocEntered    - last sales document (invoice / credit note) entered in SAP (CreateDate + DocTime);#(lf)                          documents entered after it appear after the next refresh.#(lf)    Before use replace the placeholders (4 places): PowerLoader_<client> = the Power Loader database,#(lf)    <SAP company DB> = the SAP B1 company database; sales table ETL_SA_Sales = the table the report reads.#(lf)    Both databases must be on the same SQL Server (three-part names). Save the client copy as#(lf)    PROD\<CLIENT>\BI_DataFreshness_Sales_<CLIENT>.sql.#(lf)    Run by Power BI directly, NOT as a Power Loader task: as a task BIRefreshed would be the load time#(lf)    (and Power Loader $ macros are not expanded, so the names are written in full).#(lf)    Time zone: the server clock may be in another zone, so server-local times are tagged with the server's current#(lf)    UTC offset, then converted with AT TIME ZONE 'Israel Standard Time' (summer time included).#(lf)    Needs: SQL Server 2016+; VIEW SERVER STATE for sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats (else PowerLoaderLoaded is NULL);#(lf)    SELECT on the SAP OINV / ORIN; PowerLoaderLoaded is NULL after a SQL Server restart until the next Power Loader run.#(lf)    Change log:#(lf)    2026-11-02  (1) created.#(lf)*/#(lf)SELECT#(lf)  [Z].[BIRefreshed]#(lf), CAST ( TODATETIMEOFFSET ( [L].[LastLoad], [Z].[ServerOffset] ) AT TIME ZONE 'Israel Standard Time' AS DATETIME2(0) )    AS [PowerLoaderLoaded]#(lf), CAST ( TODATETIMEOFFSET ( [D].[LastEntered], [Z].[ServerOffset] ) AT TIME ZONE 'Israel Standard Time' AS DATETIME2(0) ) AS [LastDocEntered]#(lf)FROM (#(lf)    -- report refresh time (this query runs at refresh) + server UTC offset in minutes#(lf)    SELECT#(lf)      CAST ( SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Israel Standard Time' AS DATETIME2(0) ) AS [BIRefreshed]#(lf)    , DATEPART ( TZOFFSET, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() )                                    AS [ServerOffset]#(lf)) AS [Z]#(lf)CROSS JOIN (#(lf)    -- last Power Loader write into the sales table (server local time)#(lf)    SELECT MAX ( [U].[last_user_update] ) AS [LastLoad]#(lf)    FROM sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats AS [U]#(lf)    WHERE 1=1#(lf)      AND [U].[database_id] = DB_ID ( N'PowerLoader_<client>' )#(lf)      AND [U].[object_id]   = OBJECT_ID ( N'[PowerLoader_<client>].[dbo].[ETL_SA_Sales]' )#(lf)) AS [L]#(lf)CROSS JOIN (#(lf)    -- last invoice / credit note entered in SAP: entry date + entry time (DocTime = HHMM, server local time)#(lf)    SELECT MAX ( DATEADD ( MINUTE, [H].[DocTime] / 100 * 60 + [H].[DocTime] % 100, [H].[CreateDate] ) ) AS [LastEntered]#(lf)    FROM (#(lf)                  SELECT [CANCELED], [CreateDate], [DocTime] FROM [<SAP company DB>].[dbo].[OINV]#(lf)        UNION ALL SELECT [CANCELED], [CreateDate], [DocTime] FROM [<SAP company DB>].[dbo].[ORIN]#(lf)    ) AS [H]#(lf)    WHERE 1=1#(lf)      AND [H].[CANCELED]   = 'N'#(lf)      AND [H].[CreateDate] >= DATEADD ( DAY, -60, CAST ( GETDATE() AS DATE ) )   -- last 60 days is enough for MAX#(lf)) AS [D]" ] )
in
    Source

measures.name: Label Data Freshness
measures.expression:
-- Top-right label: 3 times (Israel time, BI_DataFreshness_Sales_<CLIENT>.sql), He / En; "-" when a time is missing.
-- He lines: RLE ... PDF (UNICHAR 8235 / 8236) keep "text: date" order; the date is an LTR isolate (LRI / PDI 8294 / 8297).
VAR __CheckCulture = COALESCE ( [Selected Culture], USERCULTURE () )
VAR __Fmt          = "dd/MM/yy HH:mm"
VAR __NL           = UNICHAR ( 10 )
VAR __RtlStart     = UNICHAR ( 8235 )
VAR __RtlStop      = UNICHAR ( 8236 )
VAR __LtrStart     = UNICHAR ( 8294 )
VAR __LtrStop      = UNICHAR ( 8297 )
-- FORMAT ( BLANK () ) returns "", so a missing time is tested with ISBLANK, not COALESCE.
VAR __RefreshedDT  = MAX ( 'Date Last Refreshed'[Date Last Refreshed] )
VAR __LoadedDT     = MAX ( 'Date Last Refreshed'[Power Loader Loaded] )
VAR __LastDocDT    = MAX ( 'Date Last Refreshed'[Last Doc Entered] )
VAR __Refreshed    = IF ( ISBLANK ( __RefreshedDT ), "-", FORMAT ( __RefreshedDT, __Fmt ) )
VAR __Loaded       = IF ( ISBLANK ( __LoadedDT ),    "-", FORMAT ( __LoadedDT,    __Fmt ) )
VAR __LastDoc      = IF ( ISBLANK ( __LastDocDT ),   "-", FORMAT ( __LastDocDT,   __Fmt ) )
RETURN
    SWITCH ( TRUE ()
        , __CheckCulture = "he-IL"
            ,       __RtlStart & "רענון Power BI: "    & __LtrStart & __Refreshed & __LtrStop & __RtlStop & __NL    -- Power BI Refresh
                & __RtlStart & "טעינת SQL: "          & __LtrStart & __Loaded    & __LtrStop & __RtlStop & __NL    -- SQL load
                & __RtlStart & "מסמך מכירה אחרון: "  & __LtrStart & __LastDoc   & __LtrStop & __RtlStop           -- Last Sales Doc
        ,    "Power BI Refresh: " & __Refreshed & __NL
            & "SQL load: "        & __Loaded    & __NL
            & "Last Sales Doc: "  & __LastDoc
    )
measures.description: Top-right label: 3 times (Israel time), He / En.

measures.name: Tooltip Data Freshness
measures.expression:
-- Info icon tooltip (page TTDataFreshness): what each of the 3 label times means + refresh schedule, He / En (10 lines).
-- Names = the label measure (Label Data Freshness). He lines: RLE ... PDF (UNICHAR 8235 / 8236).
VAR __CheckCulture = COALESCE ( [Selected Culture], USERCULTURE () )
VAR __NL           = UNICHAR ( 10 )
VAR __RtlStart     = UNICHAR ( 8235 )
VAR __RtlStop      = UNICHAR ( 8236 )
RETURN
    SWITCH ( TRUE ()
        , __CheckCulture = "he-IL"
            ,        __RtlStart & "רענון Power BI - מתי הדוח קרא את הנתונים בפעם האחרונה." & __RtlStop              -- Power BI Refresh - when the report last read the data.
                & __NL
                & __NL & __RtlStart & "טעינת SQL - מתי הנתונים הועתקו מ-SAP למאגר הדוח." & __RtlStop                 -- SQL load - when the data was last copied from SAP into the report database.
                & __NL & __RtlStart & "הדוח מציג את הנתונים נכון לרגע זה." & __RtlStop                                -- The report shows the data as of this moment.
                & __NL
                & __NL & __RtlStart & "מסמך מכירה אחרון - מועד הקלדת החשבונית / זיכוי האחרונים ב-SAP." & __RtlStop   -- Last Sales Doc - when the last invoice / credit note was entered in SAP.
                & __NL & __RtlStart & "מסמכים שהוקלדו מאוחר יותר יופיעו בעדכון הבא." & __RtlStop                     -- Documents entered later appear after the next refresh.
                & __NL
                & __NL & __RtlStart & "הדוח מתעדכן כל יום בשעות (שעון ישראל):" & __RtlStop                          -- The report refreshes daily at Israel time:
                & __NL & __RtlStart & "<refresh times HH:MM, comma separated - fill per project>" & __RtlStop
        ,           "Power BI Refresh - when the report last read the data."
            & __NL
            & __NL & "SQL load - when the data was last copied from SAP into the report database."
            & __NL & "The report shows the data as of this moment."
            & __NL
            & __NL & "Last Sales Doc - when the last invoice / credit note was entered in SAP."
            & __NL & "Documents entered later appear after the next refresh."
            & __NL
            & __NL & "The report refreshes daily at Israel time:"
            & __NL & "<refresh times HH:MM, comma separated - fill per project>"
    )
measures.description: Info icon tooltip (page TTDataFreshness): meaning of the 3 times + refresh schedule, He / En.
